Marissa / team —

Confirming infra can produce the 30-day audit logging sample; Ops will drop a sanitized csv by 6/30. I put together a 2-page rollback/runbook note for dedicated -> hosted fallback (short version below). I'll attach the full runbook draft in the shared Drive.

Runbook (summary):
- Trigger: sustained token-latency >300ms p95 for 10m OR 5% request error rate for 5m.
- Automated steps: scale dedicated pool per policy (burst + reserve).
- If errors continue after two scale attempts, automated routing switches to hosted model variant (compatible model family) with traffic mirroring for 15 minutes, then full cutover if metrics improve.
- Manual escalation: PM + SRE on call; rollback to previous model version is allowed only with Exec approval within a 90-min window.

ETA for full runbook draft: 6/30 15:00 PT. I'll also provide the sanitized log sample then.

Vivek
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA-variance-summary.csv (preview)
